Koh Ngai Cliff Beach Resort - Beautiful Panorama & Luxury Accommodation
Welcome to Koh Ngai Cliff Beach Resort
Koh Ngai - Krabi, Thailand
Be mesmerized by our 200-degree panoramic ocean view from
the northern tip of Koh Ngai. Perched 20-30 meters above the sea, Koh Ngai
Cliff Beach Resort offers a unique vantage point over the Andaman Sea's
turquoise waters and surrounding islands.
Immerse yourself in a tropical paradise with a 3-kilometer pristine
white beach, lush forests, and vibrant coral reefs just steps away.
Whether you're relaxing by our cliffside pool or exploring the
underwater world, experience the ultimate island getaway where nature
meets luxury.

pages.text:
Rooms & Suites | Koh Ngai Cliff Beach Resort, Trang & Krabi
Accommodation
Luxury resort in Andaman Sea. All rooms offer the comfort of privacy including
own balcony overlooking view of the ocean.
Ocean View Suite
📏 60 sqm
The Ocean View Suite offers a spacious 60-square-metre living area with a large private balcony, opening onto a spectacular panorama of Mah Island, Chuak Island, Waen Island and Mook Island lying one after another across the horizon. Wake up to magnificent sunrises over Koh Ngai's beach, framed by lush tropical greenery.
Details
Book Now
Premier Sea View
📏 48 sqm
Premier Sea View offers a generous 48-square-metre living space with a balcony overlooking a stunning sea view and partial glimpses of the beach and tropical forest. Each room is air-conditioned and equipped with twin beds, with a small garden area and a lovely cascade just outside.
Details
Book Now
Popular
Deluxe Sea View
📏 48 sqm
Deluxe Sea View pairs a 48-square-metre living space with a private balcony framing the sea, the beach and the tropical forest beyond. Twin beds and air-conditioning come as standard, alongside a compact garden corner and a lovely cascade right outside your door.
Details
Book Now
Superior Sea View
📏 36 sqm 🌊 Partial Sea View
Each Superior Sea View has a total living area of 36 square meters, opening onto a partial sea view framed by lush tropical garden. All rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, ceiling fan and twin beds.
Details
Book Now
Superior Garden View
📏 36 sqm 🌲 Garden View
Each Superior Garden View has a total living area of 36 square meters, nestled amid lush tropical garden for a quiet, green outlook. All rooms are equipped with air-conditioning, ceiling fan and twin beds.

pages.text:
Location & Directions | Koh Ngai Cliff Beach Resort, Trang & Krabi
Location & How to Get There
Find us in paradise - Koh Ngai, Krabi Province, Thailand
Koh Ngai Cliff Beach Resort
Located on the pristine island of Koh Ngai (also known
as Koh Hai) in the Andaman Sea, our resort sits at the
northern point of this tropical paradise, offering
unparalleled ocean views and easy access to nearby
islands.
📍
Address
Koh Ngai, Krabi Province
Thailand
🌊
Island Features
3 km white sandy beach
Crystal clear warm seawaters
Lush tropical forest
🏝️
Nearby Islands
Koh Kradan • Koh Mook • Koh Cheuk
Koh Mha • Koh Rok
⛴️
Ferry Connections
Koh Phuket • Koh Lanta • Koh Phi Phi
Koh Lipe • Koh Langkawi (High Season)
Travel Map Infographic
Click to expand the map
Getting to Koh Ngai Cliff Beach Resort
Reaching our island paradise is easier than you think.
Follow these simple steps to begin your tropical adventure.
1
Bangkok to Trang
Choose your preferred mode of transportation to
reach Trang Province:
✈️
By Air (Recommended)
Flight Duration: ~1.5 hours
Airlines:
Nok Air
Air Asia
Thai Lion Air
💡 Fly directly from Bangkok to Trang
for the fastest route.
🚂
By Train
Route: Krung Thep Aphiwat
Central Terminal — Trang
Journey Duration: ~12-14
hours (overnight)
Service: State Railway of Thailand (Call Center: 1690)
💡 Enjoy Thailand's beautiful
countryside. Van/boat service available
from Trang Station.
🚌
By Bus
Route: Bangkok Bus Terminal
(Mo Chit 2) — Trang Bus Terminal
Journey Duration: ~12-13
hours
💡 Air-conditioned buses depart
regularly. Direct connection to resort
transfer available.
🚗
By Car
Route: Bangkok — Chumphon
— Tung Song — Trang — Pak Meng Pier
Highway Police Service: 1193
💡 Follow signs to Pak Meng Pier once in
Trang. Parking is available at the pier.
2
Trang to Pak Meng Pier
From Trang town or airport, travel to Pak Meng Pier:
🚗
Private Transfer (Recommended)
Duration: ~45 minutes
Distance: ~40 km
We can arrange pick-up service from
Trang Airport or town
💡 Most convenient option - we'll
coordinate with your arrival time
🚕
Taxi or Minivan
Duration: ~45 minutes
Available at Trang Airport and town
center
Negotiate price before departure
(typically 600-800 THB)
3
Pak Meng Pier to Koh Ngai
Take a Longtail boat to our island:
⛵
Longtail Boat
Duration: ~45-60 minutes
Traditional Thai boat experience
Can be arranged for private transfers
⚠️ Important Notes:
Boat schedules depend on weather and sea
conditions
During monsoon season (May-October),
services may be limited
We recommend booking transfers in advance
Free parking available at Pak Meng Pier
4
Arrival at Koh Ngai Cliff Beach Resort
Welcome to paradise! Our team will be waiting to
greet you at the beach and escort you to the resort.
Check-in Time: 14:00
Check-out Time: 11:00
Reception: 08:00 - 21:00
💡 Early check-in or late check-out may be available
upon request (subject to availability)
Let Us Handle Your Transfer
For a seamless journey, we offer complete transfer packages
from Bangkok, Trang Airport, or other locations directly to
our resort. Our team will coordinate all transportation,
ensuring you arrive relaxed and ready to enjoy your stay.
🚍 Land Transfer Rates (Van)
From To Private Van (Max 7 pax)
Trang City / Train Station Pak Meng Pier 1,500 THB
Trang Airport Pak Meng Pier 1,500 THB
Krabi City / Ao Nang Pak Meng Pier 3,300 THB
Krabi Airport Pak Meng Pier 2,800 THB
Phuket Airport Pak Meng Pier 5,500 THB
🚤 Sea Transfer Rates (Boat)
From To Chartered Boat (Max 4 pax) Shared Boat (Per Person)
Pak Meng Pier Resort 1,800 THB 400 THB
* Shared boat scheduled times: 12:00 (Pak Meng to
Resort), 08:30 (Resort to Pak Meng)
